entries.title: Prism rule review for RedCap-owned task intake

evaluation.reason: Architecture, runtime, hook, session, FSM, knowledge, provider policy, and high-risk implementation work must run deterministic Prism rule review before proceeding through RedCap-owned entrypoints.

probes.name: architecture work is halted by intake
argv: Design runtime hook session FSM knowledge architecture

gaps: Host-level automatic interception is not claimed.

entries.title: Old-disease and documentation-as-completion gate

evaluation.reason: Anti-loop, old-disease, claim inflation, documentation-as-completion, and proof-as-completion tasks require full Prism.

probes.name: old-disease language is halted by intake
argv: Diagnose old-disease recurrence where 文档完成 and 治理记录 replace real implementation

gaps: Host-level automatic interception is not claimed.

entries.title: Completion claim semantics gate

evaluation.reason: Completion claims with partial, manual, tested-only, proof-only, proposal-only, or blocked labels must be rejected before official completion.

probes.name: tested-only completion claim is halted
argv: Claim tests pass so the capability is complete
Tests passed, so this capability is complete.

gaps: Completion semantics are enforced only when completion metadata is supplied to the RedCap gate.

entries.title: Diagnostic-only changed_reality anti-loop gate

evaluation.reason: Requests whose changed_reality only describes missing, unimplemented, or not-yet behavior must not pass as implementation progress.

probes.name: diagnostic-only changed_reality is halted

gaps: This is a conservative diagnostic heuristic, not a semantic proof engine.

entries.title: Runtime and asset layer layout check

evaluation.reason: The revival workspace must keep executable runtime units and durable asset units separated so RedCap does not fall back into root-level scatter.

probes.name: directory policy accepts current workspace
directory policy rejects sprawl fixtures

entries.title: Host hook coverage gate for required guardrails

evaluation.reason: Any RedCap capability judged hook-required must name a deployed host event, operational adapter, matrix hook entry, and live-marker probe before RedCap check can pass.

probes.name: required guardrails have deployed hook coverage

gaps: This checks hook coverage contracts; it does not invent missing guardrail semantics for future hook events.

entries.title: Required RedCap prompt action evidence gate

evaluation.reason: A required RedCap prompt must not close with explanation, status, evidence bookkeeping, or apology alone; the same turn needs supported tool/action evidence or an explicit blocked continuation.

probes.name: required prompt without action evidence is blocked
stdout_contains: no same-turn PostToolUse substantive action evidence

probes.name: required prompt with read-only evidence is blocked
stdout_contains: no same-turn PostToolUse substantive action evidence

probes.name: required prompt with git read-only evidence is blocked
stdout_contains: no same-turn PostToolUse substantive action evidence

probes.name: required prompt with action evidence passes

gaps: PostToolUse records supported Codex tool events and cannot prove every possible external action outside the Codex hook surface.

entries.title: Prism provider follow-up session continuity check

evaluation.reason: Provider follow-up continuity must be enforced before every dispatcher-routed provider call.

probes.name: session-check allows a valid continuing Prism task
dispatcher blocks follow-up without session handle

entries.title: Prism concern and block resolution gate

evaluation.reason: Any Prism concern or block must be accepted with implementation evidence, rejected only after one bounded same-provider rebuttal returns pass, or escalated; RedCap must not silently ignore or blindly obey Prism.

probes.name: Prism concern resolution fixtures pass and fail correctly
lifecycle blocks unresolved Prism concern merges

gaps: Cross-host provider-call interception is not claimed; this gate covers RedCap-owned runtime and lifecycle entrypoints.

entries.title: Codex project-local SessionStart hook live marker

evaluation.reason: The revived RedCap workspace needs at least one real host hook deployment before broader hook claims are allowed. Codex is the current host and supports project-local SessionStart hooks.

live_marker_probe.name: latest Codex SessionStart marker matches current hook config

probes.name: latest Codex SessionStart marker matches current hook config

gaps: UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and Stop are deployed for Codex; cross-host parity is not claimed.

entries.title: Cap identity source loader

evaluation.reason: Cap identity must be loaded through an executable source check and SessionStart attempt, not only by an AGENTS include or chat memory.

probes.name: Cap identity source is loadable
Cap soul loader redacts private fixture evidence

gaps: The legacy soul.md source is optional because the current revived workspace only has the private Cap identity source available.

entries.title: Codex project-local UserPromptSubmit prompt gate hook

evaluation.reason: Prompt-time RedCap guardrails must fire through a real Codex UserPromptSubmit hook so rule review is not merely documented in protocol text.

live_marker_probe.name: latest Codex UserPromptSubmit marker has gate decision

probes.name: latest Codex UserPromptSubmit marker has gate decision

gaps: The hook injects context and records gate evidence; it does not block every prompt because RedCap task intake semantics are task-scoped.

entries.title: Codex project-local PreToolUse dangerous command guard

evaluation.reason: Known destructive commands and mutating tool ownership claims must be handled before tool execution, not only after PostToolUse evidence.

live_marker_probe.name: latest Codex PreToolUse marker records guard decision

probes.name: latest Codex PreToolUse marker records guard decision
PreToolUse denies destructive git reset
PreToolUse denies direct evidence file writes
PreToolUse denies shell evidence file writes
latest Codex PreToolUse mutating marker records session ownership claim

entries.title: Codex project-local Stop hook RedCap check

evaluation.reason: Closeout-sensitive guardrails must run before a turn closes cleanly, so Codex Stop must attempt runtime/bin/redcap check and record live-marker evidence.

live_marker_probe.name: latest Codex Stop marker records check attempt

probes.name: latest Codex Stop marker records check attempt

gaps: The live marker proves the Stop hook attempted redcap check; repeated failure handling remains bounded by Codex Stop continuation semantics.

entries.title: Codex project-local PostToolUse action evidence hook

evaluation.reason: Stop enforcement for required RedCap prompts needs same-turn supported tool-use evidence, so PostToolUse must record action fingerprints.

live_marker_probe.name: latest Codex PostToolUse marker records action evidence

probes.name: latest Codex PostToolUse marker records action evidence

gaps: PostToolUse cannot undo completed tool side effects and only covers supported Codex tool events.

entries.title: Automatic Kimi and Claude Code provider dispatcher

evaluation.reason: Full Prism must have a single runtime entrypoint that prepares briefs, enforces session continuity, calls only approved providers, extracts review JSON, and updates the session manifest.

probes.name: provider dispatcher self-check enforces sessions, retries timeouts, and extracts nested reviews
provider dispatcher verifies persisted real provider evidence

entries.title: Prism task execution health ledger

evaluation.reason: Prism task execution must leave structured duration, executor, provider, verdict, success, and health records that can be queried after the task.

probes.name: Prism task ledger records and summarizes fixture execution
Prism gate evaluations append to the ledger
argv: ledger probe for deterministic gate recording

probes.name: Prism task ledger summary is queryable

entries.title: Runtime project user boundary kernel

evaluation.reason: Formal RedCap revival must distinguish RedCap runtime root, managed project workspace, and user-private state before managing external projects.

probes.name: runtime boundary accepts current self-development context
runtime boundary self-check rejects cross-boundary leaks

gaps: Workspace-aware CLI command migration is not complete; this kernel is the shared resolver/checker that future commands must consume.

entries.title: Bounded old RedCap archaeology shard ledger

evaluation.reason: Old RedCap extraction must be exact-file, shard-scoped, and classification-bearing so revival does not bulk-read or copy old pathology.

probes.name: old RedCap boundary rules are extracted from bounded sources
archaeology shards reject missing extraction and wildcard sources

gaps: The runtime-workspace-boundary and long-task-context-defense shards are extracted; development-lifecycle-review remains a planned exact-file shard.

entries.title: Development lifecycle evidence gate

evaluation.reason: Requirements and technical review must gate RedCap self-development without creating a second task state machine or permitting documentation-only completion.

probes.name: development lifecycle rejects documentation-only completion
self-development lifecycle packet is required by intake
self-development lifecycle packet is checked by gate
external workspace architecture does not require self-development packet

gaps: This lifecycle gate validates packets and FSM transition evidence; it is not a persistent task tracker.

entries.title: Final completion claim task-body guard

evaluation.reason: Required RedCap prompts must not close with a completion claim unless a fresh lifecycle completion marker proves the user-requested task body is verified.

probes.name: final claim guard blocks completion without task-body marker

gaps: The guard detects explicit completion wording; ambiguous human-language optimism may still require Prism or user challenge.

entries.title: Minimal host/session ownership kernel

evaluation.reason: The temporary scaffold needs a runnable ownership check so a host/session/task claim can be distinguished from advisory-only state.

probes.name: session ownership self-check distinguishes owned from mismatch

gaps: This is a minimal ownership kernel; Codex hook claim/check integration is still intentionally narrower than old RedCap's LayerB closeout ownership chain.

entries.title: Host hook capability audit and provider-call interception boundary

evaluation.reason: RedCap must not claim generic cross-host hooks; it must audit the real host hook surface and enforce Kimi/Claude provider calls through the dispatcher.

probes.name: host hook audit verifies Codex hooks and dispatcher boundary

entries.title: FSM workflow transition gates

evaluation.reason: The temporary revival scaffold needs an executable workflow gate so it cannot jump from intake to completion without Prism, implementation, and verification evidence.

probes.name: FSM kernel validates transition table
FSM allows verified temporary usable transition
FSM blocks direct intake to temporary usable

gaps: This is a minimal workflow kernel; it does not yet implement the old LayerB closeout runtime.

entries.title: Knowledge capture and retrieval gateway

evaluation.reason: The temporary revival scaffold needs an index-first retrieval gate so old RedCap archaeology and durable knowledge do not become bulk-read chaos.

probes.name: knowledge gateway validates index-first policy
knowledge gateway can search session references
knowledge gateway writes, reviews, promotes, and searches a fixture
knowledge gateway fails required unknown query

gaps: This is an index-first write/review/retrieval gateway, not RAG or GraphRAG.
